sections.html:

Color Coated

The Lincoln booking page lists personal color analysis at US$295 for 90 minutes at Normandy Court. Its policy asks for 48 hours’ notice when rescheduling. The provider’s main site also describes a physical canvas swatch book; confirm the materials included in your chosen booking.

sections.title: Before booking in Lincoln
sections.html:
Choose a real use case before the visit: a work shirt, a jacket or the next special-occasion outfit. Ask how the palette helps you select a neutral and whether you need exact matches or can work with neighboring shades. Confirm the current address when booking; an event location and a provider’s regular studio are not always the same.

  • Which physical and digital materials are included in the US$295 booking?
  • How can I reschedule if I cannot attend?

sections.title: Make the result useful in your everyday wardrobe
sections.html: Afterwards, keep the palette with a short list of things you actually need. Compare a candidate item with two pieces you already own before buying it. The app can help you explore combinations on your phone; physical samples help when the screen and shop lighting make a shade hard to judge. A consultation is most useful when it reduces indecision rather than simply adding more colors to your list.
